text: Deletion: Offer declared unconditional with acceptances received for approximately 0.61% of Harworth's shares. Peel's shareholding is expected to be 67.11% following additional share acquisitions
New HF entrant: Governors Lane declares 1.19% (all derivatives)
Scheme document published. Meetings scheduled for 30 October
The Tribal Board advises shareholders to take no action in relation to the possible offer from Jenzabar
Scheme is sanctioned by the Court. Completion expected on 1 October 2026
